independence: Reviewer did not author JobRunner source prose or implementation; this is independent source-contract review, not translation approval.
reviewed_scope: 10 revised docstrings across module, shutdown_all, JobRunner/constructor, submit, is_busy, active_jobs, pending_jobs, cancel and shutdown;9 rendered public symbols.
checks: Inline submission invokes both callables on caller thread, reports failure/completion synchronously and returns false when either callable raises; it does not register a worker or update busy state.

Threaded submission registers worker references/pending record, then starts the thread; returned true acknowledges start, not outcome. Successful pending results dispatch through the GUI-bound relay; cancelled results no longer have a pending entry and emit no job_finished.

cancel increments generation, requests interruption, clears pending and busy immediately without waiting or forcing termination. It leaves tracked thread references; separately connected error signals can still emit job_failed.
active_jobs counts tracked references, including not-yet-retired stopped threads; shutdown clears this local registry even when bridge retains parked live threads.
shutdown_all requests cancellation across all runners before waiting; one deadline bounds waiting, not total process exit. Only normally returning shutdown calls count; failure logs and continues.
shutdown uses remaining shared deadline for each drain_thread, which requests quit, waits bounded time and parks unresponsive threads instead of terminating.

finding.before: All runners are cancelled before any wait
finding.reason: cancel exceptions are caught, so successful cancellation cannot be guaranteed.
finding.after: Cancellation is requested for all runners before any wait

validation: Read actual lifecycle implementation, owning regression bodies and bridge.drain_thread; independently verified executable AST equality. No runtime tests, collector, writer or source edits. Normal API review/generation remains documentation owner scope.
